name: Cantilever
description: A study in suspended weight — bands and settings that appear to defy gravity, echoing the cantilevered forms of modernist architecture.

name: Endgame
description: Sculptural rings and pendants drawn from the geometry of chess — every piece deliberate, every silhouette a position held.

name: The Gallery
description: Jewelry conceived as museum pieces first — plinths, frames, and negative space translated into gold and stone.

name: Monolith
description: Solid, sculptural forms inspired by brutalist massing — heavy on the eye, weightless on the hand.
